topic: Moser's Circle Problem: The Deceptive Pattern
target_audience: High school students or introductory discrete math students

sections.title: Introduction: The Quest for Partitioning
lecture_lines: Place n points on a circle.
Connect every pair with a chord.

sections.title: The Trap of Induction
lecture_lines: The sequence is one, two, four, eight.

sections.title: Prerequisite: Combinatorics Basics
lecture_lines: The result is only sixteen regions.

sections.title: The True Formula
lecture_lines: We need combinations to count intersections.
Select four points for each intersection.
Regions equal n choose four plus n choose two plus one.
